$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py UploadResponse field for field; every field is always present, nullable ones are null.
title: Upload
description: Read model of an upload, returned by POST /v1/uploads (201) and POST /v1/uploads/{id}/complete (200). Clients map an unknown state to UNKNOWN and never treat it as completed.

target.description: Path the client PUTs the raw bytes to, relative to the API origin, for example /v1/uploads/{id}/content. Opaque to the client.

max_bytes.description: Server byte limit in force for this upload.

expires_at.description: After this instant the target rejects bytes and completion with 410 UPLOAD_EXPIRED.

completed_at.description: Null until the server has verified size and SHA-256.
